wnba.Headline: Sky's DiJonai Carrington plans to make season debut vs. Sun
wnba.Description: Chicago Sky guard DiJonai Carrington plans to make her season debut on Thursday against the Connecticut Sun barring a setback pregame, she told ESPN.

wnba.Headline: Source: WNBA won't punish Bueckers, Reese for apparent wager
wnba.Description: WNBA stars Paige Bueckers and Angel Reese will not be disciplined for what appeared to be a friendly wager ahead of Wednesday's matchup, a league source told ESPN.

wnba.Headline: Storm co-owner can't attend 5 home games after fan confrontation
wnba.Description: The WNBA has suspended Seattle Storm co-owner Celeste Keaton from attending the team's next five home games after her exchange with two fans during Tuesday's matchup with the Fever.

wnba.Headline: Five players to watch ahead of Aug. 2 WNBA trade deadline
wnba.Description: Kelsey Plum, Aneesah Morrow and Betnijah Laney-Hamilton could be on the move before the WNBA trade deadline.

wnba.Headline: Portland hosts Indiana after Clark's 32-point outing
wnba.Description: Indiana Fever (18-10, 7-4 Eastern Conference) at Portland Fire (11-17, 3-9 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Washington plays Dallas, aims for 4th straight victory
wnba.Description: Dallas Wings (18-10, 8-6 Western Conference) at Washington Mystics (15-12, 9-5 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Seattle faces Atlanta following Hiedeman's 33-point outing
wnba.Description: Seattle Storm (6-24, 1-14 Western Conference) at Atlanta Dream (17-10, 9-3 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Copper and Thomas help the Mercury beat Valkyries 91-89
wnba.Description: — Kahleah Copper scored 27 points and the Phoenix Mercury overcame a 13-point deficit to beat the Golden State Valkyries 91-89 on Wednesday night in the return from the All-Star break for both teams.

wnba.Headline: Phoenix Mercury vs. Golden State Valkyries - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Phoenix Mercury vs. Golden State Valkyries, 07/29/2026

wnba.Headline: Gray and Reese lead the Dream past the Wings, 82-81
wnba.Description: — Allisha Gray scored five of her 25 points in the closing seconds and the Atlanta Dream overcame a 15-point deficit to beat the Dallas Wings 82-81 on Wednesday night in the first game for both teams since the All-Star break.

wnba.Headline: Dallas Wings vs. Atlanta Dream - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Dallas Wings vs. Atlanta Dream, 07/29/2026

wnba.Headline: Storm apologize after co-owner confronts fans for Cunningham support
wnba.Description: The Storm apologized Wednesday for an exchange that took place between one of their co-owners and two fans who thanked Sophie Cunningham in the wake of her comments supporting barring transgender girls and women from girls' and women's sports.

wnba.Headline: Fever do not answer questions about pro-Sophie Cunningham rally
wnba.Description: Sophie Cunningham and Caitlin Clark were not made available to answer postgame questions about a rally before the Fever's 105-95 win over the Storm on Tuesday night in support of Cunningham's recent comments about transgender athletes.

wnba.Headline: Connecticut visits Chicago following Taylor's 31-point game
wnba.Description: Connecticut Sun (7-21, 2-10 Eastern Conference) at Chicago Sky (9-18, 1-9 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Minnesota puts road win streak on the line against Toronto
wnba.Description: Minnesota Lynx (23-6, 15-1 Western Conference) at Toronto Tempo (10-17, 5-8 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: New York takes on Las Vegas following Stewart's 29-point game
wnba.Description: New York Liberty (16-12, 9-3 Eastern Conference) at Las Vegas Aces (19-8, 13-4 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: A'ja Wilson scores 28 as the Aces beat the Fire 98-83
wnba.Description: — A'ja Wilson finished with 28 points and 14 rebounds and the Las Vegas Aces breezed to a 98-83 victory over the Portland Fire on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: Clark's 32-point night fuels Fever's latest 100-point explosion
wnba.Description: Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell combined for 60 points for the Fever, who topped 100 points for a league-record fourth straight game and beat the Storm 105-95 on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: Breanna Stewart and Sabrina Ionescu lead Liberty to 113-109 win over skidding Sparks
wnba.Description: — Breanna Stewart had 29 points and Sabrina Ionescu scored 27 to help the New York Liberty hold off the Los Angeles Sparks 113-109 on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: Los Angeles Sparks vs. New York Liberty - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Los Angeles Sparks vs. New York Liberty, 07/28/2026
